scope: Read-only replay of an original32-point precision screen and its separately saved thermal-background review. No numerical cosmology calculation or new posterior qualification.
qualification: Fresh measurement_summary.summarize_run for the unchanged original parent; exact current target/source/data/version identities, native record seals and original chronological strata are mandatory.
replay: Verify original sealed plan, parent native records, all32native point seals, native logs/spectra and complete record manifest. Reconstruct every thermal.reviewed_row using saved backgrounds only; recompute both original.summarize outputs and require exact equality. Bind the existing fixed-native thermal validation and its source/reference hashes.
status: Preserve original and reviewed status, diagnostic flags and per-point failures. reviewed_precision_screen_supported is true only for a verified no_large_variation_detected_on_fixed32 result. Any genuine density, nonbackground or high-background closure failure remains; incomplete/nonfinite/corrupt evidence is rejected.
validation: Synthetic complete32point fixtures with qualified-parent dependency explicitly mocked: valid auxiliary-only repair; genuine precision spread; retained density/unknown failure; changed parent/record/report/source/background and NaN failures. Model construction and all CAMB background/spectrum entry points forbidden throughout.
limits: A supported finite screen means no large variation detected on these32 fixed chronological strata only. It is not posterior qualification, an accuracy-convergence guarantee, posterior reweighting, omitted covariance estimation or permission to erase the original failure. The consumer verifies arithmetic and provenance of stored backgrounds; their numerical computation was separately validated. No original pipeline receipt is changed.
